scenicChapters.title: Turkey Cappadocia Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 17 km this is Turkey Cappadocia Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-yesiloz-site-subterranean-city-of.story: A 83 km round trip from Ürgüp - roughly 1 h 26 in the saddle. It goes by way of Soganli site, Subterranean city of Kaymakli and back through Soganli site. The highest point is about 1,550 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
